name: With the memory of a long fight, its end is a big moment
case: Boop remembers that the "api" tests have kept failing for three days. Today claude finishes a long turn on "api", done, after the tests failed twice on the way and then passed. Boop knows the saga is over: a proud, excited or relieved face, a success, big or huge, never a small or plain one.
why: MEMORY (WrittenMemory.section): it can make a face or a moment bigger; PERSONALITY's Examples: a long turn done after failed checks is proud, success, huge
